childReport.manualNotes: The premise of the task appears false. The requested paper is chronologically implausible: the tabular-foundation-model literature starts with TabPFN (2022), and the earliest scaling-law study for tabular foundation models found anywhere is TabDPT (arXiv 2410.18164, 2024). The most likely real referents are TabDPT (2024) or Hog et al., 'Towards Reliable Scaling Laws for Tabular Foundation Models' (FSML 2026 workshop, Freiburg ML lab publication page). Neither shares the requested authors or year. If the parent wants a substantive answer instead of a negative result, re-issuing the task with a corrected title/year would be the right move. One arXiv ID (2610.29352) in the file is flagged in-line as not independently verified at its abstract page.
